The case: multiple persons, including company executives, fraudulently induced contractors to sign construction contracts for a non-existent project, collected deposits, guarantee money, etc. This is contract fraud (诈骗) or fraud in procurement? In Chinese criminal law, "合同诈骗罪" (contract fraud) is when one uses false facts to induce another to sign a contract and obtain property. The examples: earlier similar case (contract fraud) gave answer "合同诈骗". So likely charge: 合同诈骗.

Thus answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
